subject: ACK from reviewer_concurrency for coder
body: Concurrency lens clean — no blocking finding. The per-finding tool-call cap is concurrency-safe by construction: the cap value + mode are exported into each reviewer's OWN one-shot process env inside invoke_agent_for_event, so a wave of 5+ reviewers each enforce a per-finding budget in-process — there is no cross-reviewer shared counter, hence no race and no lock required. evaluate_finding_tool_call_cap() takes the tool_calls count as a parameter (caller-tracked within a single agent's single-threaded scratch-check loop), so this slice introduces zero concurrent-mutation surface. No shared mutable state is added: os.environ is read-only at build time, ToolCallCapDecision is frozen, and evaluate_*/tool_call_cap_log_record are pure. One-shot wrapper => fresh process per BRC event, so no cap env leaks across spawns. The top-level import from review_findings_verdict is cycle-free and resolved once at load. off-mode renders an empty block, keeping the spawn command byte-identical to the legacy path.
